name: Sword in the Slime
summary: Guard Jameson asks you to recover his training sword from an ooze west of the bay. He needs it back before his sergeant learns it is missing.

sections.title: A Lost Sword
sections.body: Jameson’s sword went fast when he tried to fight an ooze without one of his own. Now the guard needs you to search for the training blade in an ooze west of the bay and bring it back. His sergeant must not discover the loss.

faq.answer: Guard Jameson lost his training sword when it became stuck in an ooze.
Jameson believes his sword is stuck in an ooze west of the bay.

faq.q: Why does Jameson want the sword back?
faq.answer: Jameson wants the sword returned before his sergeant realizes it is missing.

faq.q: What kind of sword is missing?
